title: App Insight carousel: composable metrics screenshots for latency, cost-per-token, and trace view
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a small carousel of onboarding screenshots and captioned micro-artifacts that demonstrate the new 'App Insight' entry point: a compact set of three primary views for first-run users and SREs. The three canonical screens: 1) Latency Distribution + p50/p95/p99 sparklines, 2) Cost-per-token breakdown with historical sparkline and sample cost calc tooltip, 3) Lightweight trace lane (mini-waterfall) showing per-segment timings and automatic suggested remediation. Assets should be export-ready (PNG @2x, SVG icons) and include overlay copy for docs and the quickstart guide. Focus on clarity for three personas: Platform Engineer (latency), Product Manager (cost visibility), and Reliability Lead (traces). Avoid reusing existing observability mockphrases; propose fresh microcopy and progressive disclosure patterns for first-time users.
